name: padded shirt
_design_note: Under-armor slot. Worn beneath body armor or standalone. Gambeson/chain-shirt are both this template — material is the variation axis. Distributes impact, mitigates seam-blows.
lore_template: A close-fitting shirt of {material_name}, made to be worn alone or under heavier armor. It spreads a blow across the whole chest, and it is the last thing between the skin and a point that has found a gap.
